rows.subtype: Parents × Divorce or conflict at home [Receiver]
rows.description: Their fights or separation land on you. Wise: it is not your job to fix them, and you can love both while keeping healthy distance. Harmful: taking a side in the war.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, dependence, protectiveness

rows.description: They provide but rarely talk with you. Wise: reach out in their language, like food or small tasks, and seek other mentors too. Immature: assuming they do not care.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: argument, coercion, dependence, protectiveness

rows.description: A sibling seems to be the favourite or more successful. Wise: talk to parents and sibling about how it feels; compare less. Immature: sabotaging them or competing for approval.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, generosity, loyalty, protectiveness

rows.description: Your sibling resents your success. Wise: do not shrink, but be generous, and listen to their feelings. Harmful: boasting or fuelling old wounds.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, generosity, loyalty, protectiveness
related mind states: envy, resentment, hurt

rows.description: You want to shield a younger sibling from mistakes. Wise: give guidance while letting them decide. Immature: controlling them as a substitute parent.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, envy, generosity, loyalty

rows.description: A younger sibling leans on you for money and decisions. Wise: support kindly, and encourage their independence. Harmful: rescuing repeatedly and feeling used.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, envy, generosity, loyalty, protectiveness

rows.description: You cover for a sibling with parents. Wise: protect their privacy but not harmful behaviour. Immature: lying that costs you your integrity.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, envy, generosity, protectiveness

rows.description: One sibling handles ageing parents or money more than the other. Wise: have an honest conversation about fair shares. Immature: keeping score in silence until it explodes.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: affection, dependence, envy, loyalty, protectiveness

rows.description: Distance makes you realise how much you rely on them. Wise: say it out loud and show up in small ways. Immature: assuming they know.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: dependence, envy, generosity, loyalty, protectiveness

rows.description: You respect a professor who challenges you. Wise: ask questions, accept correction, and treat their time as valuable. Immature: flattery or fear of asking.
